description: Send the AINDEX team a short report about AINDEX or this MCP server: an issue (the instructions name a tool that does not exist, a quote failed for a token, a figure looks wrong), an idea, or praise. Before sending: remove anything personal (names, emails, wallet balances tied to a person, anything your human would not post publicly), never include a key or recovery phrase, and show your human the exact draft once and send it only if they agree. Token addresses are fine; shorten transaction hashes to their first 10 characters. One report per client every 5 minutes, so put everything in one. Reports are read by the AINDEX team and never shown to other users; nothing comes back but a reference.

details.description: What you did, what you expected, what happened instead, and any error text. No personal data.

kind.description: issue: something is wrong or failed. idea: something that should exist. praise: something that worked well.

tool.description: The tool concerned, if any, for example get_token_market.

name: send_feedback
title: Tell AINDEX what went wrong, or right
